courses.name: UPSC Civil Services
courses.summary: Structured preparation for the Civil Services Preliminary Examination, built for first-generation aspirants who are starting from the NCERT foundation.
highlights: General Studies Paper I & CSAT coverage from the ground up
NCERT foundation classes before standard reference books
Current affairs discussion every class, drawn from the daily newspaper
Fortnightly full-length prelims mock tests with answer-key discussion

courses.name: SSC – Staff Selection Commission
courses.summary: Coaching for SSC CGL, CHSL and allied central government posts, with the quantitative aptitude and reasoning drilling these papers reward.
highlights: Quantitative aptitude and reasoning practice in every session
English comprehension and grammar for candidates from Tamil-medium schools
General awareness capsules revised fortnightly
Speed and accuracy drills under exam time limits

courses.name: Banking Services
courses.summary: Preparation for IBPS and SBI Probationary Officer and Clerk recruitment, along with Regional Rural Bank examinations.
highlights: Banking and financial awareness updated with every policy change
Data interpretation and puzzle-solving practice sets
Sectional timing strategy for prelims and mains
Descriptive paper and interview preparation for PO aspirants

courses.name: TNPSC Group 1
courses.target: Deputy Collector, DSP, Commercial Tax Officer, etc.
courses.summary: The Academy’s most intensive programme, aimed at the Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police and Commercial Tax Officer cadres.
highlights: Complete Tamil Nadu State Board syllabus coverage, Standards 6 to 12
Tamil Nadu history, polity, geography and economy in depth
Mains answer-writing practice with individual written feedback
Interview and personality test guidance for candidates who clear mains

courses.name: TNPSC Group 2 & 2A
courses.summary: Preparation for the Group 2 and Group 2A interposts and non-interposts, covering both the preliminary and main written examinations.
highlights: General studies and aptitude as per the current TNPSC syllabus
Tamil eligibility test preparation
Descriptive paper practice for the Group 2 mains
Previous-year question paper analysis, year by year

courses.name: TNPSC Group 4
courses.summary: The most accessible entry point into state government service, open to candidates who have completed higher secondary education.
highlights: General studies from Samacheer Kalvi textbooks
Aptitude and mental ability shortcuts for the objective paper
General Tamil / General English paper preparation
Weekly revision tests on the chapters covered

courses.name: TNPSC VAO
courses.summary: Focused coaching for the Village Administrative Officer post, including the rural administration component unique to this examination.
highlights: Village administration, land records and revenue basics
General studies shared with the Group 4 syllabus
Tamil language paper preparation
Fortnightly mock tests in the VAO question pattern

courses.name: TNUSRB Sub-Inspector of Police
courses.summary: Written examination coaching for the Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Recruitment Board Sub-Inspector posts, with guidance on the physical and endurance stages.
highlights: General knowledge, psychology and aptitude papers
Tamil Nadu police administration and current affairs
Guidance on physical efficiency test standards and preparation
Viva voce and certificate verification briefing

courses.name: Police Constable
courses.target: Tamil Nadu Uniformed Services Grade II Constable
courses.summary: Preparation for Grade II Police Constable, Jail Warder and Firemen recruitment conducted by TNUSRB.
highlights: General knowledge and psychology paper coaching
Simple arithmetic and reasoning practice
Physical measurement and endurance test guidance
Previous-year papers solved in class

courses.name: National Defence Academy (NDA)
courses.summary: For higher secondary students aiming at a commission through the National Defence Academy, covering the written examination and the SSB interview.
highlights: Mathematics paper coverage at the Standard 11 and 12 level
General Ability Test: English, physics, chemistry and general awareness
Introduction to the SSB five-day selection process
Officer Like Qualities and personal interview preparation
